text:
maria: Hey team — opening a single thread to request project approval + quota increases for a cross-region GPU pool. Project: redwood-dedicated-eu4 (project number 876543210). We want to launch a small Dedicated capacity pilot for EU customers with US fallback.

maria: Requested quotas (initial):
- H100 (a2-highmem style): europe-west4 from 12 -> 48
- A100 (a2-highgpu): europe-west4 from 8 -> 32
- L4: europe-west4 from 0 -> 24
- regional static external IPs: europe-west4 from 16 -> 64
- internal (IN_USE_ADDRESSES) europe-west4 from 50 -> 200
- inter-region egress quota bump (to allow peering/fallback): 2Gbps -> 10Gbps

maria: Business justification: onboarding two paying pilots (fintech and healthcare) that require EU-resident inference. Dedicated capacity reduces latency for their SLAs and keeps data in-region. We also need the US fallback to avoid downtime during capacity shortages. Cost estimate: ~160k USD/mo if fully provisioned; initial commit will be ~40k USD/mo. Billing account: 01A2B3-CUST. Need org approval for creating the project and then quota increases. ETA for rollout: target week of 2026-04-05. cc @chad @leo

chad: Thanks — can you paste the exact payload you plan to submit to GCP and the contact on the pilot side? Also need confirmation that KMS keys and audit logging are set up on the proj.

maria: Pilot contacts: Julia (fintech) and Marco (healthcare). KMS: yes, we have a customer-managed key in the org KMS, key ring "redwood-eu-keys". Audit logs are enabled.

maria: Planned JSON payload for the quota request (we'll submit via console/support case):
```json
{
  "project": "redwood-dedicated-eu4",
  "requested_changes": [
    {"metric":"NVIDIA_H100_GPUS","region":"europe-west4","target":48},
    {"metric":"NVIDIA_A100_GPUS","region":"europe-west4","target":32},
    {"metric":"NVIDIA_L4_GPUS","region":"europe-west4","target":24},
    {"metric":"REGIONAL_EXTERNAL_IPS","region":"europe-west4","target":64},
    {"metric":"IN_USE_ADDRESSES","region":"europe-west4","target":200},
    {"metric":"NETWORK_EGRESS_BPS","region":"global","target":"10000000000"}
  ],
  "justification":"Dedicated capacity pilot for EU customers, production SLA testing, fallbacks to us-central1. Data residency and low-latency requirements explained. Billing account 01A2B3-CUST."
}
```

leo: Couple of asks: 1) Can we add a line to request quota on us-central1 as a warm-failover (H100: 8, A100: 8, L4: 12)? 2) We should request preemptible quotas where possible to lower cost for batch jobs.

maria: Good call. I'll add fallback counts for us-central1 and mark preemptible pool separately in the request.

rachel: For approval flow: People ops / compliance flagged that any project with customer data needs a data processing addendum and a compliance attestation. Is the compliance checklist filled for this project?

maria: Yes, compliance checklist completed (see Confluence: https://redwood.internal/confluence/dedicated-eu4-checklist) and DPA signed for both pilot customers.

tina: FYI, GCP has spotty H100 capacity in eu-west4 historically. We should add a second EU region as explicit fallback (europe-west1 or europe-west3) for critical workloads or ask GCP to confirm capacity. Otherwise we risk having quotas but no physical machines.

maria: Adding europe-west1 as secondary fallback for small numbers (H100: +8). Will also ask GCP to confirm availability in support case.

quota-bot: Support case created: CASE-329102 (https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/329102). Current status: Case opened, awaiting GCP response.

chad: Once GCP confirms capacity we'll need finance signoff on the committed spend. @finance please review the cost projection in comment thread.

maria: Action items: 1) I've opened the support case (CASE-329102). 2) Updated the JSON payload with us-central1 and europe-west1 fallbacks. 3) Added preemptible pools note. 4) Requesting project approval from infra leads — can @chad and @leo sign off so we can submit to GCP today?

leo: Approved from infra side pending finance. :thumbsup:

chad: Approved pending a short runbook for fallback routing and autoscaler config. Can you attach the runbook before submission?

maria: Will attach runbook (brief) and the autoscaler policy by EOD. Thanks everyone.

quota-bot: CASE-329102 updated by GCP: "Acknowledged, need org policy and billing confirmation. ETA 48-72 hours."

maria: Noted — I'll upload the org policy docs and billing confirmation now.
